conflicts.source: 2026 LoD2 parent DEBE00YY1tw0009x has measuredHeight 13.086 m and one flat roof at scene Y 18.286 over the full complex.
conflicts.resolution: Retain every original source surface and all ten official holes; supplement only mapped upper building-part footprints. Architect publishes maximum 30 m. Main comb 26 m and gatehouses 17 m are display estimates below that maximum, not measured heights.

conflicts.source: OSM maps wings with 8 levels and central bar with 10; architect publishes 9 overall.
conflicts.resolution: Use OSM only for stepped plan boundaries and relative hierarchy; cap displayed main height at the primary published 30 m. Window bay widths, level pitches, cladding offsets and portal dimensions remain display estimates.
